about_the_game:
This pack includes:

  • A premium squad of 4 engineers and 1 radioman of level 4, equipped with the Winchester G30R semi-automatic rifle.
  • The radiomen have the ability to call in rocket artillery.
  • 300 gold.
  • Unique nickname decorator.
  • Unique portrait.

The Winchester G30R is an experimental semi-automatic rifle developed by Winchester Repeating Arms in the 1940s. It was presented to the US War Department as an alternative to the M1 Garand. One of the features of the Winchester G30R is the alignment of the gas piston body with the return spring. The gas-operated system ensures reliable operation, reducing recoil and increasing the rate of fire. The rifle uses 7.62 caliber ammunition with a detachable 20-round magazine. Additionally, the rifle is equipped with a bayonet.
